title: Vocabulary Traps
npcIntro: Tricky words today — small mistakes change everything.
npcOutro: Vocab on point. The barista nods respectfully.

exercises.phraseCard: make (NOT do) a coffee / a tea

exercises.prompt: Pick the right phrasal verb: "I just ____ to grab a latte before work."
She's allergic ____ dairy, so she takes oat milk.
What does "I'll get this round" most likely mean at a café?
choices: I'll pay for everyone's drinks this time.
exercises.phraseCard: get / buy this round = pay for everyone's drinks

exercises.prompt: The coffee was so ____ I couldn't finish it.
You hear: "I'd kill for a coffee right now." — meaning?
choices: I really, really want a coffee.
I would fight someone for coffee.
exercises.phraseCard: I'd kill for X = I really want X
